chunks: Al-ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim narrated from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about a woman who menstruates in the month of Ramadan before the sun sets. He said, “She breaks her fast when she begins menstruating.”

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman about whom the legal ruling is being asked
key_terms.تَغِيبَ الشَّمْسُ: the sun sets; the time of sunset
key_terms.حِينَ: at the time when; immediately when
key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, in which fasting is obligatory

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a woman begins menstruating before sunset in Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who begins menstruating before sunset in the month of Ramadan. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that her fast ends at the onset of menstruation, establishing the ruling for this situation in fasting jurisprudence.
